title: Heroes of Newerth: 8.1M accounts breached
summary: In December 2012, the multiplayer online battle arena game known as Heroes of Newerth  was hacked and over 8 million accounts extracted from the system. The compromised data included usernames, email addresses and passwords.

title: vBulletin: 519K accounts breached
summary: In November 2015, the forum software maker vBulletin suffered a serious data breach. The attack lead to the release of both forum user and customer accounts totalling almost 519k records. The breach included email addresses, birth dates, security questions and answers for customers and salted hashes

title: Gamigo: 8.2M accounts breached
summary: In March 2012, the German online game publisher Gamigo was hacked and more than 8 million accounts publicly leaked. The breach included email addresses and passwords stored as weak MD5 hashes with no salt.

title: Nexus Mods: 5.9M accounts breached
summary: In December 2015, the game modding site Nexus Mods released a statement notifying users that they had been hacked.
